summary: Smith et al. report 31 hypothalamic genes with a KO-minus-WT effect after adjustment for body weight. HypoExplorer estimates the genotype difference across the four KO and four WT libraries without that adjustment. The reviewed sources yielded no author effects for the registered genotype-only comparison.

manualReview.summary: Published hypothalamic effects adjust for body weight
manualReview.note: The GEO family SOFT records and sample archive identify four WT and four KO male hypothalamus libraries. Their genotype assignments and count totals match the registered sample sheet and raw library sizes. Figure 3A labels ten genes from the weight-adjusted analysis. Supplementary Table 1 lists enrichment P values and contributing objects for ten process networks and ten pathway maps. The registered edgeR model includes genotype alone.
reviewFlags: The retained GEO series HTML is a reCAPTCHA challenge. Cohort and count evidence comes from the family SOFT, series matrix and sample archive. The historical input match remains structural.

verificationReview.reason: The author DESeq2 coefficient estimates KO minus WT at a fixed modeled body weight. The registered edgeR coefficient estimates KO minus WT across the observed groups. Figure 3A gives selected gene labels for the adjusted effect. Supplementary Table 1 gives enrichment statistics. The public sources reviewed yielded no author reference for the genotype-only effect.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain identifiable author KO-minus-WT effects or directions from a genotype-only hypothalamus analysis of GSM6523623–GSM6523630, with the model and scope documented. For an inference and coverage review, also obtain the full tested list, filtering details, raw P values and adjusted P values.
